summary: Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS, x86_64, 2 CPUs, 3931 MiB memory, 38.1 GiB disk free

findings.required: Docker Engine 24 or later from a deb package
findings.remedy: Remove it (snap remove docker) and run oap again to install Docker Engine. The snap's confinement blocks the shared socket OAP's Caddy uses.
